body.x: Advance Solution Co., Ltd. (CEO Chae Doohyun) announced its participation in CES 2025, held in Las Vegas from January 7 (Tuesday) to January 10 (Friday), as part of the K-Startup Pavilion.

Since 2021, Advance Solution has introduced robotic solutions based on autonomous driving technologies, including Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR) and disinfection robots tailored to specific needs. The company offers diverse solutions, from custom-designed robots to diagnosing and addressing client challenges, enhancing operational efficiency and competitiveness.

Recognized for its capabilities, Advance Solution received the Minister of SMEs and Startups Award in 2023, its third year in business. The following year, it garnered industry attention at Robot World 2024 with its disinfection robot ‘CLIBO.’

The company plans to expand its reach through participation in domestic and international exhibitions. It will leverage CES 2025, the world’s largest tech exhibition, as a platform to enter the global advanced robotics market.

CLIBO, the company's flagship product, will be a highlight at CES 2025. This autonomous robot uses specialized wavelengths to sterilize surfaces and air by eliminating viruses and harmful bacteria while purifying the air.

The robot operates without emitting harmful substances and includes an automated battery and filter replacement station, ensuring easy maintenance. Equipped with advanced sensing systems, CLIBO detects contamination levels, focusing on highly polluted areas for sterilization and air purification. It simultaneously establishes efficient driving routes for seamless operations.

Designed with in-house technology, the robot’s durable outer shell enhances robustness while promoting component standardization, significantly reducing production time and costs. According to the company, this approach lowers clients' purchase costs and provides greater flexibility for product line expansion.

"Advance Solution was honored with the 2024 K-Design Award for its innovative design that eliminates screw marks and minimizes mold use," a company representative stated. "This technology also enables flexible customization, allowing for tailored products and bespoke robots to meet diverse client needs."

By showcasing CLIBO at CES 2025, Advance Solution aims to lay the foundation for global expansion. "The U.S., with its abundance of multi-use facilities and increasing interest in automated systems for facility management, presents a significant opportunity for CLIBO," a representative explained. "We plan to use this event to validate its potential, discover new clients, and identify strategic partners."

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
